title: ADR-0009 still specifies the status vocabulary as read from backlog/config.yml, and nothing supersedes it
summary: ADR-0009 (Story/Task coupling and reconciliation) says the status vocabulary is read from Backlog config (backlog/config.yml) at lines 50, 138 and 205. The code has not done that unconditionally since the tracker backend became polymorphic: the flow comes from TrackerAdapter.statusFlow(), which Backlog, Quest and Jira each answer differently. No ADR supersedes 0009 on this point (0020 covers tracker version gates, not backend polymorphism), so the architecture of record still describes a Backlog-only design that shipped away. Surfaced while fixing LCLI-503, which was the same staleness in src/core/reconcile.ts's error hints and header prose; that half is fixed. Deliberately not folded into LCLI-503: amending versus superseding an ADR is a decision about the record, not a code change, and the fleet's retirement-scope rule says history is left alone rather than rewritten. Likely shape: a new ADR recording that the status flow is backend-polymorphic, with 0009 marked superseded on that point only.

finalSummary:
Decision: SUPERSEDE, not amend-in-place. Filed a new ADR-0022 (Tracker status flow is backend-polymorphic, not Backlog config) that supersedes ADR-0009 on the status-vocabulary-source point only, via 'lore supersede adr/0009-story-task-coupling-reconciliation adr/0022-...' (no --rewrite-links -- inbound links to ADR-0009 for its still-valid coupling design deliberately stay pointed at 0009, mirroring how ADR-0018 partially superseded ADR-0015 without rewriting its inbound links).

WHY SUPERSEDE OVER AMEND: this repo already has both conventions. 'Amended' (ADR-0007, 0011, 0013, 0014) is used when a mechanism changes beneath an unchanged decision. Here the original DECISION ITSELF -- vocabulary read from backlog/config.yml -- is the sentence that stopped being true, replaced by a substantially different design (TrackerAdapter.statusFlow(), three different sources) worthy of its own Context/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives. That is the same shape as ADR-0018 superseding ADR-0015 'for persistence and indexed routing' while leaving ADR-0015's still-valid no-vector boundary active and untouched.

ADR-0009 NOT silently rewritten: frontmatter got status: superseded + superseded_by (via lore supersede, which also reformatted tags:/summary: to block YAML style -- ADR-0011 canonical-order serialization, not a content edit). Body got ONE new paragraph appended to the Status section naming the scope, reason, date and LCLI-506; Context/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives are byte-for-byte unchanged -- verified via git diff.

Architecture of record: ADR-0022's Decision section names all three backends' actual statusFlow() sources verified against src/adapters/{backlog,quest,jira}.ts: Backlog reads backlog/config.yml's statuses: key (readStatusFlow, falls back to a built-in default flow); Quest calls the live 'task status-flow --json' subprocess (no config file of its own); Jira reads lore's OWN .lore/config.toml [tracker.jira] status_flow, never Jira's REST service. Also cross-linked from docs/reference/backlog-cli-contract.md's Tracker adapter boundary section (the day-to-day reference doc, not just the ADR), since a grep across docs/ confirmed no other summary doc restates the stale Backlog-only claim (architecture.md, agent-onboarding.md, lore-design.md, cli-surface.md all cite ADR-0009 generically without repeating it).

lore check: exit 0, 80 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 9 out-of-bundle links skipped (unrelated, pre-existing).

NOT DONE (deliberately, noted in ADR-0022's own 'Left out of scope'): no ADR exists for the broader decision that lore has three interchangeable tracker backends at all (TrackerAdapter itself, backend selection/migration) -- that gap predates and is bigger than this task's narrow status-vocabulary correction; ADR-0022 documents where each backend's status flow is sourced from, not why lore is backend-polymorphic in the first place.

That write was reverted with 'git restore' before any commit, and all real work was redone from a fresh .claude/worktrees/lcli-506 worktree off origin/dev. Final diff touches only: docs/adr/0009-*.md, docs/adr/0022-*.md (new), docs/adr/index.md, docs/log.md, docs/reference/backlog-cli-contract.md, .quest/tasks/LCLI-506.json -> .quest/completed/.
